channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: What happens after approving a Gnosis Bridge withdrawal?
item.description: What happens after approving a token bridge withdrawal? Approval sets an ERC-20 allowance; submit a separate bridge transaction, then track the source and destination.

item.title: Bridged tokens in MetaMask: Ethereum-side import
item.description: How to add a bridged token to MetaMask after a Gnosis Chain withdrawal: claim it on Ethereum, then import its verified Ethereum contract address.

item.title: How energy and bandwidth work on TRON when swaps burn TRX
item.description: How energy and bandwidth work on TRON: swaps use Energy for contract execution, and wallets burn TRX when staking or delegation leaves a shortfall.

item.title: Gnosis Bridge returns tokens to Ethereum through a claim
item.description: How to bridge tokens from Gnosis Chain to Ethereum: submit the return transfer, wait for validation, claim on Ethereum and verify the recipient balance.

item.title: What mistakes happen when adding an EVM network to a wallet?
item.description: Common mistakes when adding a network to a crypto wallet include a wrong Chain ID or RPC, a testnet mix-up and missing tokens; verify each before sending.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Stolen Crypto
item.description: The court-authorized action covers part of the more than $2.7 billion frozen after a $6 billion Binance theft attributed by the FBI to North Korea.

item.title: Injective Veyra vote clears quorum ahead of Nov. 16 close
item.description: Injective proposal 717 has exceeded its 33.4% quorum, with voting open until Nov. 16 and the v1.21.0 upgrade targeted for Nov. 24 if approved.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance funds
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance assets, part of a wider freeze tied to a North Korean hack.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2B in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, part of $2.7 billion frozen.

item.title: US secures authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority over more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds as US and private partners continue tracing and freezing funds.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as stablecoin settlement tops $25B
item.description: Visa added Monad on Nov. 10 as a stablecoin settlement route for participating issuers and acquirers, while its network-wide annualized pace exceeded $25 billion.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added the Monad blockchain as a settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, while Monad says a privacy feature is due in coming months.

item.title: Kim Yo Jong denies North Korea role in Binance hack
item.description: Kim Yo Jong denied North Korea's role in Binance's $6 billion theft after the FBI blamed TraderTraitor, renewing a dispute over the attack and stolen funds.

item.title: Treasury orders MEXC cut off over alleged $16.7B in illicit flows
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial institutions to block transfers involving MEXC, citing $16.7 billion in Russian illicit finance and links to Iran, North Korea and cybercrime.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34 billion hack
item.description: Binance says a fake September job interview helped attackers reach wallet systems before $6.34 billion in assets were impacted during the Oct. 29 theft.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. transfer cutoff for MEXC over alleged $16B flows
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. firms to block MEXC transfers, citing at least $16 billion in illicit flows; the ban takes effect 30 days after Federal Register publication.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block spacing to 25 seconds and adding fee reserves that begin supporting mining rewards in 2031.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance in an Oct. 29 attack and is urging crypto firms to block related transactions.

item.title: Berachain bridge approvals set how much a contract can spend
item.description: A token approval lets a bridge contract spend a stated amount; it does not itself move funds, and any unused allowance can remain active after the transfer.

item.title: Schroders launches emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana
item.description: Schroders has launched tokenized exposure to its emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana through Centrifuge, giving investors blockchain-based shares in a feeder fund.
